controls.title: Perimeter fence
controls.objective: A continuous fence encloses the site perimeter.

questions.guidance: Walk the full perimeter and note any gaps.

questions.text: What is the fence height in meters?
questions.guidance: Measure at three points and record the lowest.

controls.title: Crypto inventory (fixture)
controls.objective: An inventory of cryptographic assets is maintained.

questions.text: Does a current crypto inventory exist?
questions.guidance: Ask for the inventory and check its date.
